top_signals.title: Binance brushes off Lagarde MiCA speculation, reaffirms Europe commitment
top_signals.summary: Binance declined to address reports of ECB intervention in its Greek MiCA bid, saying it remains committed to securing authorization in Europe.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Prudential Exits AlexForbes as Motsepe’s ARC Boosts Stake
top_signals.summary: A firm linked to billionaire Patrice Motsepe is consolidating control of Alexander Forbes Group Holdings Ltd. through a deal that will see US financial-services giant Prudential Financial Inc. exit its investment in South Africa’s biggest standalone retirement-fund administrator.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
